qobuz_provider.label: Qobuz account
qobuz_provider.description: Native Qobuz music-provider instance used to resolve tracks, fetch Connect tokens, and apply stream-quality changes.

publish_name.label: Name shown in the Qobuz app

http_port.label: HTTP discovery port
http_port.description: Port the Qobuz app connects to on this host. Change only if it clashes with another service or you need to open it explicitly through a firewall.

initial_volume.label: Fallback connect volume
initial_volume.description: Volume reported to the Qobuz app on connect when the target player's current volume can't be read (e.g. Auto mode with no player available). When a target player is known, its current volume is used instead.

manifest.description: Makes Music Assistant appear as a device in the official Qobuz app via Qobuz Connect.
